end.summary:
Practised what lions, deer, and caterpillars eat.
Built and read food chains using arrows in four examples.
Explained that arrows point from food to the eater.
Predicted that fish would have no food if the larvae were removed.
Initially said dead leaves would break down slowly, then gave the English explanation correctly.
end.parentNote: Manav practised plant-eaters, meat-eaters, and food chains. They used the food-to-eater arrow method correctly across examples and explained what happens when food is removed. There was a brief mix-up about what happens to leaves, and it was corrected in the next response. At home, ask them to draw one food chain and explain each arrow aloud.
